headline: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
context: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.
